title: Find the name of the event with the highest total attendance among all 'Mee
question: Find the name of the event with the highest total attendance among all 'Meeting' type events where at least one expense was categorized under 'Advertisement'.

prediction.sql:
SELECT e."XCL_011"
FROM event AS e
INNER JOIN attendance AS a ON e."XCL_010" = a."XCL_001"
WHERE e."XCL_013" = 'Meeting'
  AND e."XCL_010" IN (
    SELECT b."XCL_009"
    FROM budget AS b
    INNER JOIN expense AS ex ON b."XCL_003" = ex."XCL_023"
    WHERE b."XCL_004" = 'Advertisement'
  )
GROUP BY e."XCL_010", e."XCL_011"
ORDER BY COUNT(a."XCL_001") DESC
LIMIT 1
